prophets|title: Azmz n lanbiya d rrusul d lktub n ignna
prophets|subtitle: Zɣ Adam ɣifs ssalam ar Ɛisa ɣifs ssalam
prophets|summary: Kraḍ d ɛcrin n nnbi d rrasul ɣ yat tsnsla n ttawḥid, nttni d lktub n ignna: Ṣṣuḥuf n Ibrahim d Musa, Ttawrat, Zzabur, d Linjil.
prophets/first-fathers/adam|subtitle: Baba n bnadm d amzwaru n lanbiya
prophets/first-fathers/adam|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: ixlq t Llah s ufus nns, iṣuḍ ɣifs zɣ rruḥ nns, issujd as lmalayka nns, isslmd as ismawn akkʷ.
prophets/first-fathers/adam|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: tanbaḍt ɣ wakal, tagi n Iblis d ttkbbr nns, akayad n tsklut n ljnnt d lwswasa, ukan ttuba d usti ﴿فَتَلَقَّىٰ آدَمُ مِن رَّبِّهِ كَلِمَاتٍ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ﴾.
prophets/first-fathers/adam|lines.2: Tiwṣṣatin d lktub: asnti n ttawḥid d tiwṣṣatin tizwura, d ttuba d listiɣfar.
prophets/first-fathers/sheth|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: mmi-s n Adam d lxlifa nns ɣ wakal, d lwṣiy nns ɣ tḥḍa n tarwa nns d uḥḍu n ccrɛ n ttawḥid.
prophets/first-fathers/sheth|lines.1: Asatal: tamttla n tsutiwin n imwaḥḥidn f ttawḥid iṣfan mraw n lqrun gr Adam d Nuḥ.
prophets/first-fathers/idris|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: nnbi ikrmn ifulki t Llah s tidt d ṣṣbr, imun dids nnbi ﷺ ɣ ignna wis kkuẓ ɣ yiḍ n lmiɛraj.
prophets/first-fathers/idris|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: tidt d nnubuwwa d tullya n lmqam ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِدْرِيسَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَّبِيًّا * وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا﴾.
prophets/first-fathers/idris|lines.2: Ṣṣbr: ﴿وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾.
prophets/first-messengers|title: Nuḥ, amzwaru n rrusul, d igdudn imzwura
prophets/first-messengers/nuh|subtitle: Amzwaru n rrusul d amqqran n imrsal
prophets/first-messengers/nuh|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: amzwaru n rrasul lli d iznza Llah ɣ tggira n ccirk ɣ wakal, zɣ ulu lɛazm n rrusul.
prophets/first-messengers/nuh|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: iɣra i ugdud nns ifḍ n useggʷas ɣas smmus d mraw n useggʷas s ṣṣbr d ujhad, iskr lbabbur s lwaḥy n Llah, aṭufan amqqran, aɣrrq n mmi-s lli iɛṣan, d tnjjit n imuminn ﴿وَقِيلَ يَا أَرْضُ ابْلَعِي مَاءَكِ﴾.
prophets/first-messengers/nuh|lines.2: Tiwṣṣatin: ttawḥid iṣfan, d tbrriyt zɣ ṣṣnam (Wadd, Suwaɛ, Yaɣut, Yaɛuq, d Nasr), d tanmmirt i tiɣufa n Llah.
prophets/first-messengers/hud|lines.0: Agdud d udɣar: iznza t Llah s tqbilt n Ɛad ɣ Lʔaḥqaf (Ḥaḍramawt d unẓul n Tgzirt), ayt lbni ittawin d tadwast.
prophets/first-messengers/hud|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ismktay asn tiɣufa n Llah, ifl asn ttjbbr ﴿أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ آيَةً تَعْبَثُونَ * وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ﴾.
prophets/first-messengers/hud|lines.2: Taggara: skkrkisn as ugdud d ttkbbr nnsn, ihlk tn Llah s yan waḍu iṣmmiḍn ijhdn ittusxxrn ɣifsn sa n yiḍan d tam n wussan ttmttaḍfarn, ismnjji Llah Hud d wid as umnnin.
prophets/first-messengers/salih|lines.0: Agdud d udɣar: iznza t Llah s Tamud ɣ Lḥijr (agafa n Tgzirt n waɛrabn), wid ittqqazn tiddar ɣ idurar s ufrraḥ.
prophets/first-messengers/salih|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ttrn ugdud yat lmuɛjiza, isufɣ asn Llah tlɣmt d lmuɛjiza ibaynn, iḥḍu tn ad tt ssmmasn s lbas ﴿هَٰذِهِ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَكُمْ آيَةً فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِي أَرْضِ اللَّهِ﴾.
prophets/first-messengers/salih|lines.2: Taggara: iɣrṣ asmmaṭṭaw nnsn i tlɣmt ɣ tggira n tḥilt n imqqurn nnsn, ar tn tamẓ tɣuyyit d tergigit, ar asn d iẓru ṣṣbaḥ ɣ tgmmi nnsn ttugrnnin f igʷmmaḍ nnsn.
prophets/ibrahim-house|title: Azmz n Ibrahim ɣifs ssalam d tarwa nns
prophets/ibrahim-house|subtitle: Ibrahim, Luṭ, Cuɛayb, Ismaɛil d Isḥaq, Yaɛqub, Yusuf
prophets/ibrahim-house/ibrahim|subtitle: Xalil Llah d lmam n lḥunafaʔ
prophets/ibrahim-house/ibrahim|lines.0: Ṣṣifa d udɣar: lmam n ttawḥid, ahrraz n ṣṣnam, zɣ ulu lɛazm n rrusul, baba n lanbiya.
prophets/ibrahim-house/ibrahim|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: amsasa nns d win dids imsasan f Rbbi nns, d umsasa nns d ugdud nns, aluḥ nns ɣ tmssi lli as yuɣaln d asmmiḍ d ssalam, lhijra s wakal ibarkn d Makka, abnu n Lkaɛba d Ismaɛil ﴿وَإِذْ يَرْفَعُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ الْقَوَاعِدَ مِنَ الْبَيْتِ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ﴾, d ukayad n tɣrsi tamqqrant.
prophets/ibrahim-house/ibrahim|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Ṣṣuḥuf n Ibrahim ﴿صُحُفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/lut|lines.0: Tamlalt d udɣar: mmi-s n gʷma-s n Ibrahim ɣifs ssalam, iumn dids iḥajr dids, ukan iznza t Llah s ayt Sadum ɣ Ɣawr Lʔurdun.
prophets/ibrahim-house/lut|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ifl asn lfaḥica ixcnn lli ur jjun iskr yan ɣ bnadm dat nsn, ikkat tamnnaɣt nnsn ﴿أَتَأْتُونَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ مِّنَ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/lut|lines.2: Taggara: tirzi n lmalayka i Ibrahim ukan i Luṭ, tuffɣa n Luṭ d ayt tgmmi nns s yiḍ, d uhlak n tmṭṭuṭ nns lli iqqimn d ugdud s unẓar n iẓṛan d ubddl n tgmmi nnsn: afella nns iga wadda nns.
prophets/ibrahim-house/shuayb|lines.0: Agdud d udɣar: iznza t Llah s ayt Madyan d ayt Layka (agafa-utaram n Tgzirt n waɛrabn).
prophets/ibrahim-house/shuayb|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ifl asn aẓḍam ɣ lkil d lmizan, d lfsad ɣ wakal d tuxxṛa n ubrid ﴿أَوْفُوا الْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْمُخْسِرِينَ * وَزِنُوا بِالْقِسْطَاسِ الْمُسْتَقِيمِ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/shuayb|lines.2: Taggara: ttḍṣan gis imqqurn n ugdud nns skkrkisn as, ar tn yamẓ waɛḍab n wass n tdgnut d tergigit n tɣuyyit, ar asn d iẓru ṣṣbaḥ ɣ tgmmi nnsn ttugrnnin zund ur gis jjun llin.
prophets/ibrahim-house/ismail-ishaq|line: Ismaɛil ɣifs ssalam: bab n tidt ɣ lwaɛd, nnbi n Makka, jddi-s n nnbi Muḥammad ﷺ d waɛrabn lmustaɛriba, imun d baba-s ɣ ubnu n Lkaɛba ﴿وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ صَادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًا نَّبِيًّا﴾.

Isḥaq ɣifs ssalam: lbcara ibarkn i Sara d Ibrahim ɣ twssirt, nnbi ikrmn, baba-s n Yaɛqub, zɣ tarwa nns a d ttmttaḍfarn lanbiya n Bani Israʔil ﴿وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yaqub|lines.0: Aẓar d udɣar: mmi-s n Isḥaq mmi-s n Ibrahim ɣifsn ssalam, ttinin as «Israʔil», ɣur s ttmunn Bani Israʔil akkʷ d lʔasbaṭ nnsn mraw d sin.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yaqub|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ṣṣbr ifulkin f tbḍḍa d sin tarwa nns Yusuf d Binyamin ﴿فَصَبْرٌ جَمِيلٌ وَاللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ﴾, d tilla n lyaqin s rrḥmt n Llah ﴿إِنَّمَا أَشْكُو بَثِّي وَحُزْنِي إِلَى اللَّهِ﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yaqub|lines.2: Tawṣṣit taneggarut: tawṣṣit nns ur itmttaḍn i tarwa nns ɣ lmut, ad bddn f ttawḥid d ddin ilḥnifn ﴿مَا تَعْبُدُونَ مِن بَعْدِي قَالُوا نَعْبُدُ إِلَٰهَكَ وَإِلَٰهَ آبَائِكَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِلَٰهًا وَاحِدًا﴾.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yusuf|lines.0: Aẓar d ṣṣifa: akrim mmi-s n ukrim mmi-s n ukrim mmi-s n ukrim (Yusuf mmi-s n Yaɛqub mmi-s n Isḥaq mmi-s n Ibrahim), ifka as Llah azgn n tifawt d tussna n usfru n tirgitin.
prophets/ibrahim-house/yusuf|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ifulki tiḥkayin; aluḥ nns s wanu s lḥsad zɣ ayt mas, azzenz nns ɣ Maṣr, asnkkr n tmṭṭuṭ n Lɛaziz d ṣṣbr d lɛiffa ɣ lḥbs, asfru n tirgit n ugllid, tanbaḍt f ixzainn n wakal, ukan amun n twacunt d usujd n imawlan d ayt mas, ar tḥqqa tirgit ﴿إِنَّ رَبِّي لَطِيفٌ لِّمَا يَشَاءُ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms|title: Zɣ Ayyub ar Lyasaɛ: Ttawrat d Zzabur
prophets/torah-psalms|subtitle: Ayyub, Ḍu Lkifl, Yunus, Musa d Harun, Yucaɛ, Dawud, Sulayman, Ilyas, Lyasaɛ
prophets/torah-psalms/ayyub|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: nnbi ikrmn, ifka as Llah ayda d twacunt d tarwa, ukan ijrrb t ɣ tfekka nns d uyda nns d tarwa nns, iṣbr.
prophets/torah-psalms/ayyub|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ṣṣbr amqqran bla acetki i yan ur igin Llah, ar ttiwtn s lmital ɣ ṣṣbr ﴿إِنَّا وَجَدْنَاهُ صَابِرًا نِّعْمَ الْعَبْدُ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/ayyub|lines.2: Lfrj: ddɛwa nns s uxcuɛ ﴿أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ﴾, yamr as Llah ad ikkat akal s uḍar nns ﴿ارْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ﴾, irar as Llah ṣṣḥt nns d twacunt nns d zund nttni dids nsn, d rrḥmt d usmktay i wid ittɛbadn.
prophets/torah-psalms/dhulkifl|lines.0: Ṣṣifa d usmktay: ismktay t Llah taɛala ɣ Lqurʔan lkrim d lanbiya, ifulki t s ṣṣbr d ṣṣlaḥ.
prophets/torah-psalms/dhulkifl|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ﴿وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ كُلٌّ مِّنَ الصَّابِرِينَ * وَأَدْخَلْنَاهُمْ فِي رَحْمَتِنَا إِنَّهُم مِّنَ الصَّالِحِينَ﴾, d ﴿وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|subtitle: Ḍu Nnun, bab n uslm amqqran
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|lines.0: Adɣar d tuznt: iznza t Llah s ayt Ninawa ɣ Lɛiraq, ɣikad ifl lqqis zgisn, iffɣ yuggʷa dat ad as yadn Rbbi nns.
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: tali ɣ lbabbur iɛmmrn, lqurɛa lli ɣifs tḍr, aluḥ nns ɣ ilg d ulmmaẓ nns s uslm.
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|lines.2: Ddɛwa n lkarb: ttasbiḥ nns d ddɛwa nns ɣ tillas n ilg d yiḍ d tɛbbut n uslm ﴿لَّا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/yunus|lines.3: Tanjjit d taggara: aluḥ nns ɣ yan wakal ixlan, d tmɣi n tsklut n lyaqṭin ɣifs, d ttuba n ugdud nns lli ssuttin fllasn aɛḍab n lḥcuma ﴿إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّا آمَنُوا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/musa-harun|lines.0: Adɣar d ṣṣifa: Musa, kalim Llah, zɣ ulu lɛazm; d gʷma-s Harun, lwazir nns, bab n yils ifṣṣḥn.
prophets/torah-psalms/musa-harun|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: tga yat zɣ tiḥkayin ugar ittusmmaktayn ɣ Lqurʔan; tlalit nns d uluḥ nns ɣ ilg, tarbit nns ɣ tgmmi n Firɛawn, tuffɣa nns s Madyan, awal n Llah dids ɣ Ṭṭur, tisa n lmuɛjizat d umnaɣ d Firɛawn d isḥḥarn nns, abḍu n ilg d uɣrrq n Firɛawn d iɛskrin nns, d tuḍḍrin n Bani Israʔil kkuẓ id mraw n useggʷas.
prophets/torah-psalms/musa-harun|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Ttawrat (ɣ lalwaḥ) ﴿وَكَتَبْنَا لَهُ فِي الْأَلْوَاحِ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْعِظَةً وَتَفْصِيلًا لِّكُلِّ شَيْءٍ﴾, d Lfurqan d nnura d tifawt.
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|title: Yucaɛ mmi-s n Nun ɣifs ssalam
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|subtitle: Bab n lfatḥ n wakal iqddsn
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|lines.0: Ṣṣifa d uẓar: aɛyyal n Musa d anlmad nns lli dids imunn ɣ ubrid n Majmaɛ Lbaḥrayn bac ad mlqqan d Lxaḍir ﴿وَإِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِفَتَاهُ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|lines.1: Taḥkayt d lmqam: nnbi n Llah lli iṭṭfn taɣda n Bani Israʔil ɣ tggira n lmut n Musa d Harun ɣ tuḍḍrin, isawl asn ar lfatḥ n Bayt Lmaqdis d ukcam s wakal iqddsn.
prophets/torah-psalms/yusha|lines.2: Lmuɛjiza: tbdd as tafukt s lamr n Llah ar ismmd lfatḥ, zund mad iwala nnbi ﷺ.
prophets/torah-psalms/dawud|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: agllid d nnbi, ifka as Llah yan umsli ifulkin s lḥmd, isslqqu as uzzal ar iskar ddruɛ ijhdn.
prophets/torah-psalms/dawud|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: inɣa Jalut amqqran d nnṣr n Ṭalut ﴿وَقَتَلَ دَاوُودُ جَالُوتَ وَآتَاهُ اللَّهُ الْمُلْكَ وَالْحِكْمَةَ﴾, ttasbiḥ n idurar d igḍaḍ dids ṣṣbaḥ d tadggʷat ﴿يَا جِبَالُ أَوِّبِي مَعَهُ وَالطَّيْرَ﴾, d ufṣṣl n lxiṭab ɣ lḥukm.
prophets/torah-psalms/dawud|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Zzabur ﴿وَآتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ زَبُورًا﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/sulayman|subtitle: Mmi-s n Dawud d ugllid amqqran
prophets/torah-psalms/sulayman|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: iwrt Dawud ɣ nnubuwwa d tgldit, ifka as Llah yat tgldit ur ifulkin i yan ɣ tggira nns.
prophets/torah-psalms/sulayman|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: asxxr n waḍu d ljnun d bnadm, afham n tutlayt n lmaxluqat d igḍaḍ (taḥkayt n tbibbit d tgʷḍfit), d taḥkayt n lɛarc n Bilqis tagldit n Saba d usllm nns dids i Llah Rbb lɛalamin ﴿قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَانَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/sulayman|lines.2: Abrid: tanmmirt i tiɣufa d ttwaḍuɛ i Ugllid n tidt ﴿هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّي لِيَبْلُوَنِي أَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/ilyas|lines.0: Aẓar d udɣar: nnbi zɣ lanbiya n Bani Israʔil, iznza t Llah s ayt Baɛlabak ɣ Ccam.
prophets/torah-psalms/ilyas|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: ifl i ugdud nns aɛbad n ṣṣnm (Baɛl), iɣra tn s Rbb lɛalamin ﴿أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ الْخَالِقِينَ * اللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ آبَائِكُمُ الْأَوَّلِينَ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/ilyas|lines.2: Afulki n Lqurʔan: iskkrkis as ugdud nns ar ttqqan aɛḍab, iḥḍu Llah asmktay nns i dima ﴿سَلَامٌ عَلَىٰ إِلْ يَاسِينَ * إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِي الْمُحْسِنِينَ﴾.
prophets/torah-psalms/alyasa|lines.0: Lmqam d uẓar: amddakkʷl n Ilyas ɣifs ssalam d lxlifa nns ɣ uɣra n Bani Israʔil s nnhj d ccrɛ.
prophets/torah-psalms/alyasa|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: afulki ifulkin ɣifs d lanbiya ifulkin ﴿وَاذْكُرْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَذَا الْكِفْلِ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ الْأَخْيَارِ﴾, d usmmuqqr nns f lɛalamin ɣ lfaḍl d liman ﴿وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ وَالْيَسَعَ وَيُونُسَ وَلُوطًا وَكُلًّا فَضَّلْنَا عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ﴾.
prophets/gospel|title: Zakariya d Yaḥya d Ɛisa: Linjil
prophets/gospel|subtitle: Zakariya d Yaḥya, Ɛisa mmi-s n Maryam
prophets/gospel/zakariya-yahya|lines.0: Zakariya ɣifs ssalam: bab n tḥḍa n Maryam ɣ lmiḥrab, ddɛwa nns s uffr ɣ twssirt ﴿رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ﴾, ar as ttuwalan s Yaḥya.
prophets/gospel/zakariya-yahya|lines.1: Yaḥya ɣifs ssalam: nnbi, ssid, lḥaṣur, ifulkin d imawlan nns, ifka as Llah lḥukm ɣ temẓi nns, iṭṭf Ttawrat s tdwast ﴿يَا يَحْيَىٰ خُذِ الْكِتَابَ بِقُوَّةٍ﴾.
prophets/gospel/isa|title: Ɛisa mmi-s n Maryam ɣifs ssalam
prophets/gospel/isa|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: awal n Llah d rruḥ zɣ ɣurs, ilul zɣ yat tfrut tazddgt bla baba d lmuɛjiza i lɛalamin, zɣ ulu lɛazm n rrusul.
prophets/gospel/isa|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: awal nns ɣ ukrrus iga arba, lmuɛjizat n ujjiy n iddrɣl d ubrṣ d usdr n immutn s lidn n Llah d uxlaq n igḍaḍ zɣ talaxt, tiḥilt n usṣlb nns, d tnjjit nns d tullya nns s ignna ﴿وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوهُ وَلَٰكِن شُبِّهَ لَهُمْ بَل رَّفَعَهُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ﴾.
prophets/gospel/isa|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Linjil, ar issḥqqa Ttawrat lli dat s illan, ar ibccr s Bab n tggira n rrusul ﴿وَمُبَشِّرًا بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِن بَعْدِي اسْمُهُ أَحْمَدُ﴾.
seal|title: Muḥammad ﷺ — Bab n tggira n lanbiya d Lqurʔan lkrim
seal|subtitle: Zɣ tlalit ar asmmd n ddin
seal|lines.0: Lmqam d ṣṣifa: bab n tggira n lanbiya d rrusul, rrḥmt i lɛalamin, lmam n imttqin, bab n ccfaɛa tamqqrant d lḥawḍ lli ttaskan.
seal|lines.1: Taḥkayt ɣ Lqurʔan: asnti n lwaḥy ɣ Ɣar Ḥiraʔ («Ɣr»), abayyn n ddɛwa, Lisraʔ d Lmiɛraj, lhijra d ubnu n lumma, ljihad ɣ ubrid n Llah, d usmmd n tɣufut ﴿الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ﴾.
seal|lines.2: Lktab lli yuzn Rbbi: Lqurʔan lkrim; aneggaru n lktub n ignna, lmuɛjiza lli ur itmttaḍn, lmhimin f lktub lli t izwarn, ittuḥḍa s uḥḍu n Llah ikmmln ar ass n lqiyama ﴿إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ﴾.

seal/makki/al-anam|d0|b0.3.9|text: ﴿وَأَنَّ هَٰذَا صِرَاطِي مُسْتَقِيمًا فَاتَّبِعُوهُ وَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا السُّبُلَ﴾

seal/makki/yunus|d0|b0.1.0|label: Yiḍ d uzal d tafukt d ayyur
seal/makki/yunus|d0|b0.1.1|text: D unkar n imcrikn ɣ tggira n tnjjit
seal/makki/yunus|d0|b0.2|label: Tiḥkayin n lanbiya d ssunan n tnjjit d uhlak
seal/makki/yunus|d0|b0.2.0|label: Nuḥ ɣifs ssalam d ugdud nns
seal/makki/yunus|d0|b0.2.1|label: Musa d Harun ɣifsn ssalam d Firɛawn
seal/makki/yunus|d0|b0.2.1|text: ﴿فَالْيَوْمَ نُنَجِّيكَ بِبَدَنِكَ لِتَكُونَ لِمَنْ خَلْفَكَ آيَةً﴾
seal/makki/yunus|d0|b0.2.2|text: ﴿إِلَّا قَوْمَ يُونُسَ لَمَّا آمَنُوا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْيِ﴾
seal/makki/yunus|d0|b0.3|text: ﴿وَاتَّبِعْ مَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيْكَ وَاصْبِرْ حَتَّىٰ يَحْكُمَ اللَّهُ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ الْحَاكِمِينَ﴾
seal/hijra|title: Lhijra n nnbi s Lmadina (ɣ 53 n useggʷas)
seal/hijra|lines.0: Ayenna iḍrn: amuttg zɣ Makka s Lmadina lmunawwara
seal/hijra|lines.1: Tasnt n ubḍḍu: asnti n uzmz n Lmadina d uzmz ahijri (1 H)
seal/hijra|lines.2: Abddl: zɣ tsurft n ddɛwa d ṣṣbr s tsurft n ttamkin d ubnu n ddula
seal/hijra|lines.3: Amddakkʷl nns ɣ lhijra: Abu Bakr Ṣṣiddiq iṛḍa Rbbi fllas ﴿إِذْ يَقُولُ لِصَاحِبِهِ لَا تَحْزَنْ إِنَّ اللَّهَ مَعَنَا﴾
seal/hijra|lines.4: Abnu amzwaru: timzgida n Qubaʔ ukan timzgida n nnbi, d tagʷmat gr Lmuhajirin d Lʔanṣar
seal/madani|lines.0: Tiɣzi: 10 n iseggʷasn (zɣ 53 ar 63 n useggʷas n umud / 11 H = 632)
seal/madani|lines.2: Agbur agejdan: abnu n ddula d ccrɛ d lʔaḥkam n lfiqh
seal/madani|lines.3: Awal iggutn: «A yan d wid umnnin»
seal/madani|lines.4: Ṣṣifa tamatayt: afṣṣl n lmuɛamalat d lʔaḥkam d ubnu n tmetti tamslmt
seal/madani|lines.5: Ayenna iḍrn ugar: taɣzawt n Badr (2 H), taɣzawt n Uḥud (3 H), taɣzawt n Lʔaḥzab (5 H), ṣṣulḥ n Lḥudaybiya (6 H), lfatḥ n Makka (8 H), d lḥijja n lwadaɛ (10 H)
seal/madani/ghazawat|summary: Tiɣzawin lli ismktay Lqurʔan lkrim niɣ gisnt d ttazdarnt lʔayat nns; ar gisnt ittlmad umumn is nnṣr zɣ dar Llah ad iga, d is ṭṭaɛa d ubddad ad igan abrid nns.
seal/madani/ghazawat/badr|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ﴿وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ﴾ (Al Ɛimran 123), gis d tazdar ssurt n Lʔanfal.
seal/madani/ghazawat/badr|lines.2: Ass n Lfurqan: amlilli amqqran amzwaru gr imslmn d imcrikn, ɣ inṣṛ Llah imuminn idrusn ﴿يَوْمَ الْفُرْقَانِ يَوْمَ الْتَقَى الْجَمْعَانِ﴾ (Lʔanfal 41).
seal/madani/ghazawat/uhud|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: lʔayat zɣ ssurt n Al Ɛimran ﴿وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَاعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ﴾ (Al Ɛimran 121).
seal/madani/ghazawat/uhud|lines.2: Almud: ṭṭaɛa n rrasul ﷺ d ssebba n nnṣr, d lbla ar issmyaz wid iṣdqn ﴿وَلِيَعْلَمَ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ (Al Ɛimran 140).
seal/madani/ghazawat/bani-nadir|lines.0: Akud: aseggʷas wis kkuẓ n lhijra
seal/madani/ghazawat/bani-nadir|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ssurt n Lḥacr ﴿هُوَ الَّذِي أَخْرَجَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ مِن دِيَارِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ الْحَشْرِ﴾ (Lḥacr 2).
seal/madani/ghazawat/bani-nadir|lines.2: Ssebba: rẓan lɛhd lli gr asn d nnbi ﷺ.
seal/madani/ghazawat/ahzab|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ssurt n Lʔaḥzab ﴿إِذْ جَاءُوكُم مِّن فَوْقِكُمْ وَمِن أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ﴾ (Lʔaḥzab 10).
seal/madani/ghazawat/ahzab|lines.2: Abddad n imuminn: ɣzan lxandaq ɣ tama n Lmadina, nnan ﴿هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ﴾ (Lʔaḥzab 22).
seal/madani/ghazawat/fath|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ﴿إِذَا جَاءَ نَصْرُ اللَّهِ وَالْفَتْحُ﴾ (Nnaṣr 1).
seal/madani/ghazawat/fath|lines.2: Ayenna iḍrn: ikcm nnbi ﷺ s Makka iṛbḥ, iṣfa Lkaɛba zɣ ṣṣnam, isamḥ i ayt nns.
seal/madani/ghazawat/hunayn|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ﴿وَيَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ إِذْ أَعْجَبَتْكُمْ كَثْرَتُكُمْ فَلَمْ تُغْنِ عَنكُمْ شَيْئًا﴾ (Ttawba 25).
seal/madani/ghazawat/hunayn|lines.2: Almud: nnṣr zɣ dar Llah ad iga, machi s tuggt n uṭṭun.
seal/madani/ghazawat/tabuk|lines.0: Akud: Rjab 9 H, tga taneggarut ɣ tɣzawin n nnbi ﷺ
seal/madani/ghazawat/tabuk|lines.1: Ɣ Lqurʔan: ssurt n Ttawba ﴿الَّذِينَ اتَّبَعُوهُ فِي سَاعَةِ الْعُسْرَةِ﴾ (Ttawba 117), ɣmkan a as ttinin «Taɣzawt n tmara».
seal/madani/ghazawat/tabuk|lines.2: Almud: tuffɣa ɣ tmara, d usmyaz n wid iṣdqn d lmunafiqin.
seal/madani/al-baqara|subtitle: Asjhd n lɛaqida d ubnu n ddula
seal/madani/al-baqara|lines.1: Ttaqwa ɣ Lbaqara = liman s lɣib
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0|label: Ttaqwa ɣ Lbaqara = liman s lɣib
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0|text: Asjhd n lɛaqida d usizdg n iman
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.0|text: 3 n lʔayat: ṣṣifat nnsn, ugar n gisnt liman s lɣib ﴿الَّذِينَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْغَيْبِ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.2|text: 13 n laya: lɛib nnsn ugar, ttmnḍalan gr sin iɣrbaln
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.3.0|label: Lḥsad d lkibr d lkufr s tussna
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.3.1|label: Lḥikma n uxlaq n Adam ɣifs ssalam d lfaḍl n tussna
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.4.1|text: Asmmun n lḥaqq d lbaṭil, nttni ssnn lḥaqq ﴿وَلَا تَلْبِسُوا الْحَقَّ بِالْبَاطِلِ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.0.5|text: Amdya ifulkin ugar n win ibddan lxilafa ɣ wakal ar issllam i Llah ﴿قَالَ أَسْلَمْتُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ﴾
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1|text: Lʔaḥkam n ccrɛ i ubnu n ddula tamslmt d tmetti n nnur
seal/madani/al-baqara|d0|b0.1.3|label: Tawacunt: tamɣra d lmut n tmɣra (ṭṭlaq)
seal/madani/al-imran|lines.1: Ammas n ssurt: ttaqwa (ṣṣbr, tidt, lqunut, linfaq, listiɣfar)
seal/madani/al-imran|lines.2: Agmu n ttaqwa: abddad (ɣ lɛaqida d lxdmt)
seal/madani/al-imran|lines.3: Isem n Llah lli iggutn ɣ ssurt: Lmalik d Lḥakim
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0|label: Al Ɛimran: ttaqwa ← agmu nns abddad
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0|text: Lḥizb amzwaru: asjhd n «Ur illi wnna ittyaɛbadn s lḥaqq abla Llah» ɣ wulawn ﴿شَهِدَ اللَّهُ أَنَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0|label: Amdya n win ur ibddn: ttmyal n wulawn n nnaṣara
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0.0|label: Asbdd n lḥujja fllasn ɣ ccubuhat nnsn
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0.0|text: ﴿إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ آدَمَ خَلَقَهُ مِن تُرَابٍ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0.1|label: Tirit n ddunit: tirit n Ugllid
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.0.2|text: ﴿تَعَالَوْا إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَاءٍ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.2|label: Anhay ɣ usmddkl d ikafrn ɣ umkan n imuminn
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.0.2|text: ﴿لَّا يَتَّخِذِ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الْكَافِرِينَ أَوْلِيَاءَ مِن دُونِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.0|text: ﴿رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.1.1|text: ﴿وَمَن يَعْتَصِم بِاللَّهِ فَقَدْ هُدِيَ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.2.0|text: ﴿فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنْهُ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.2.2|text: ﴿إِن تُطِيعُوا الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِكُمْ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.3|text: Lḥizb wis sin: asmɣur n wawal n «Ur illi wnna ittyaɛbadn s lḥaqq abla Llah» s ljihad
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.3.0|text: Nnṣr zɣ dar Llah ad iga, d usmyaz n wid iṣdqn d lmunafiqin
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.3.1|text: ﴿إِنَّمَا اسْتَزَلَّهُمُ الشَّيْطَانُ بِبَعْضِ مَا كَسَبُوا وَلَقَدْ عَفَا اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ﴾
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.3.1.0|label: Ajhhd n tḥḍa: ssmaḥ d lajr ɣ Ḥamraʔ Lʔasad
seal/madani/al-imran|d0|b0.3.1.0|text: ﴿الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِن بَعْدِ مَا أَصَابَهُمُ الْقَرْحُ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|subtitle: Ssurt n lɛadl d liḥsan d izrfan n imḍlumn
seal/madani/an-nisa|lines.0: Anaw n ssurt: tamadanit (zɣ ssabɛ ṭṭiwal), tbdu s yan uɣra amakki: ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ﴾ bac ad tsbdd aẓar n bnadm ar ttatr lɛadl.
seal/madani/an-nisa|lines.1: Ssebba n yism nns: aḥuḍu f izrfan n imḍlumn s umata, d tmɣarin d igujiln d tiklatin s uzlay, d usmmqqr n tmṭṭuṭ d ufṣṣl n izrfan nns.
seal/madani/an-nisa|lines.2: Tamlalt n usnti nns d taggara nns: tbdu s ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ اتَّقُوا رَبَّكُمُ﴾ tkmml s ﴿يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ قَدْ جَاءَكُم بُرْهَانٌ﴾, tbdu s lwrt tkmml s laya n «Lkalala» bac ad tḥḍu azrf n ultma (tawtmt).
seal/madani/an-nisa|lines.3: Isem iggutn ɣ ssurt: Lmalik (d dids: Rraqib, Lḥasib, Ccahid, Lɛalim, Lḥakim, Lmuqit, Lwakil, Lqadir); acku win iǧhdn ur ra iḥbbs aḍlam i win iḍɛfn abla iɣ issfrs s tmuɣli n Ugllid Afllay.
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0|text: Lɛadl d liḥsan d izrfan n imḍlumn
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0|text: Akfa n kraygatt bab n uzrf azrf nns
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.1|label: Arar n lʔamanat i ayt nsnt
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.1|text: ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَأْمُرُكُمْ أَن تُؤَدُّوا الْأَمَانَاتِ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهَا﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.2|label: Ugar n yat tmṭṭuṭ s tiwtilt n lɛadl
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.3|label: Lḥukm s lɛadl, wakkʷa i win ur igin amslm
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.0.3|text: ﴿إِنَّا أَنزَلْنَا إِلَيْكَ الْكِتَابَ بِالْحَقِّ لِتَحْكُمَ بَيْنَ النَّاسِ بِمَا أَرَاكَ اللَّهُ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.1.0|label: Tittit n lmal n igujiln s uḍlam
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.1.1|text: Arẓẓu n lɛuhud, tiɣrsi n lanbiya, lbuhtan f Maryam, d tlla n usṣlb n Ɛisa ﴿وَمَا قَتَلُوهُ وَمَا صَلَبُوهُ﴾
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.2|text: Aǧǧu n uzrf s tirit d ulkam n tasga n lfaḍl
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.2.1|label: Akfa zɣ lwrt i wid t ilkmnin ɣ tbḍḍit
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.2.2|label: Liḥsan i imawlan d imqqrabn d ujaru d umddakkʷl
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.3.0|label: Tḥḍa n igujiln d lmal nnsn
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.3.1|label: Ṣṣdaq n tmṭṭuṭ d lwrt nns
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.0|text: Lqiwama d taɣart d usfrḍ n lmal, d usmuttg imik s imik ɣ ujjiy n nnucuz bac ad tḥḍu twacunt, d tuzna n sin lḥakam i ṣṣulḥ
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.1|text: Lḥurma n tittit n lmal s lbaṭil, d lḥurma n tɣrsi n iman, d ugdal n lkbaʔir
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.2|text: Ṭṭaɛa n Llah d rrasul d ulu lamr, attḥakam s rrasul ﷺ, aṭṭaf n lḥḍr, lkaffara n tɣrsi s tuccḍa, tẓallit n tiggdi d usmẓẓi n tẓallit ɣ ubrid
seal/madani/an-nisa|d0|b0.4.3|text: Anhay ɣ lɣuluw d usbdd n is Ɛisa iga bnadm ﴿إِنَّمَا الْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ وَكَلِمَتُهُ﴾, d unkar n ttatlit
seal/madani/al-maida|subtitle: Ssurt n lɛuqud d usmmd n ddin d ccrɛ
seal/madani/al-maida|lines.0: Anaw n ssurt: tamadanit (zɣ ineggura n ma d iḍrn zɣ Lqurʔan lkrim)
seal/madani/al-maida|lines.2: Ammas agejdan: aḥḍu n lɛuqud d lɛuhud, asmmd n ccrɛ, d usnbbḍ n lḥlal d lḥram d tmlilin n ccrɛ.
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.0.2|label: Lʔaḥkam n uslay d liḥram d ccɛaʔir n lḥijj
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.0|text: Lmita d idammn d uksum n uḥlluf
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.1.1|text: Tirmt n ayt lktab, d tmɣarin lmuḥṣanat zɣ tmuminin d ayt lktab
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2|label: Akmmal n ddin d usmmd n tɣufut
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.2|text: Tazdar ɣ lḥijja n lwadaɛ ﴿الْيَوْمَ أَكْمَلْتُ لَكُمْ دِينَكُمْ وَأَتْمَمْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ نِعْمَتِي وَرَضِيتُ لَكُمُ الْإِسْلَامَ دِينًا﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.3.0|label: Lɛadl d win dik immsasan d win dik imxalafn
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.3.0|text: ﴿وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَآنُ قَوْمٍ عَلَىٰ أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا اعْدِلُوا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.3.1|label: Taḥkayt n sin tarwa n Adam d lḥurma n idammn
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.3.1|text: ﴿مَن قَتَلَ نَفْسًا بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍ أَوْ فَسَادٍ فِي الْأَرْضِ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَتَلَ النَّاسَ جَمِيعًا﴾
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.3.2|label: Lḥudud n lḥiraba d tukrḍa, d lqiṣaṣ ɣ tiddmatin
seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.4|label: Ayt lktab d lmitaq n ttawḥid

seal/madani/al-maida|d0|b0.4.2|text: ﴿مَا قُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِلَّا مَا أَمَرْتَنِي بِهِ أَنِ اعْبُدُوا اللَّهَ رَبِّي وَرَبَّكُمْ﴾
seal/madani/al-anfal|lines.2: Akud n tzdart: ɣ tggira n tɣzawt n Badr tamqqrant (2 H)
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.0|text: ﴿يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْأَنفَالِ قُلِ الْأَنفَالُ لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ﴾
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.1|text: ﴿إِنَّمَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ الَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.1.0|label: Tazayda n liman s tɣuri n lʔayat nns
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.2.0|text: ﴿إِذْ تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ فَاسْتَجَابَ لَكُمْ أَنِّي مُمِدُّكُم بِأَلْفٍ مِّنَ الْمَلَائِكَةِ مُرْدِفِينَ﴾
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.3|text: ﴿إِذَا لَقِيتُمْ فِئَةً فَاثْبُتُوا وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا﴾
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.3.2|label: Ṭṭaɛa n Llah d rrasul nns
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.5|text: ﴿وَإِن جَنَحُوا لِلسَّلْمِ فَاجْنَحْ لَهَا وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.6.0|text: ﴿وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّمَا غَنِمْتُم مِّن شَيْءٍ فَأَنَّ لِلَّهِ خُمُسَهُ﴾
seal/madani/al-anfal|d0|b0.7|text: ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَهَاجَرُوا وَجَاهَدُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِينَ آوَوا وَّنَصَرُوا أُولَٰئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقًّا﴾

seal/madani/at-tawba|d0|b0.1.0|label: Nnṣr n Llah i rrasul nns ﷺ
seal/madani/at-tawba|d0|b0.2|label: Amyaz n ṣṣfuf d ukccf n lmunafiqin
seal/madani/at-tawba|d0|b0.2|text: Lɛudur nnsn, d tḍṣṣa nnsn, d timzgida n Ḍḍirar
seal/madani/at-tawba|d0|b0.4|text: ﴿لَقَدْ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَالْأَنصَارِ﴾
seal/madani/at-tawba|d0|b0.5|text: ﴿لَقَدْ جَاءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيْهِ مَا عَنِتُّمْ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُم بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ رَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ﴾

seal/wafat|lines.3: Asmmd n tuznt: taggara n lwaḥy d ubbi nns d usmmd n tɣufut («Ass-a kmmlɣ awn ddin nnun»)

ummah/rashidun/caliph-1|title: Abu Bakr Ṣṣiddiq iṛḍa Rbbi fllas
ummah/rashidun/caliph-1|lines.0: Imgalln n rridda d umun amzwaru n Lqurʔan lkrim ɣ lmuṣḥaf.
ummah/rashidun/caliph-2|title: Ɛumar mmi-s n Lxaṭṭab iṛḍa Rbbi fllas
ummah/rashidun/caliph-2|lines.0: Lfutuḥat timqqranin, abnu n imdinn, asbdd n ddawawin d uzmz ahijri.
ummah/rashidun/caliph-3|title: Ɛutman mmi-s n Ɛaffan iṛḍa Rbbi fllas
ummah/rashidun/caliph-3|lines.0: Amun n lumma f yan lmuṣḥaf lmam (lmuṣḥaf alɛutmani) d tuzna nns s imuḍan akkʷ.
ummah/rashidun/caliph-4|title: Ɛli mmi-s n Abi Ṭalib iṛḍa Rbbi fllas
ummah/rashidun/caliph-4|lines.0: Asjhd n lqaḍaʔ d lfiqh n nnawazil ɣ lfitan.
ummah/rashidun/caliph-5|title: Lḥasan mmi-s n Ɛli iṛḍa Rbbi fllasn
ummah/rashidun/caliph-5|lines.0: Tiɣzi n lxilafa: iṭṭf tt ɣ tggira n lmut n baba-s Ɛli mmi-s n Abi Ṭalib iṛḍa Rbbi fllas s ccahada, tqqim ɣ ugʷns n sḍiṣ ayyurn ar sa.
ummah/rashidun/caliph-5|lines.1: Aseggʷas n Ljamaɛa: iǧǧa tt bac ad iḥḍu idammn n imslmn, ad imun awal n lumma (41 H).
ummah/umayyad|subtitle: Asnti n tira tunṣibt s ubrid
ummah/umayyad|summary: Iẓṛa uzmz Alʔumawi yan umuttg amqqran zɣ tira tafrdit imẓẓin s tira tunṣibt ittusnbbḍn ddaw tḥḍa n ddula tamslmt, acku tmɣur tmazirt, d bac ad ittuḥḍa ccrɛ.
ummah/umayyad/am-al-jamaa|lines.0: Tiɣzi n lxilafa n Lḥasan mmi-s n Ɛli iṛḍa Rbbi fllasn: iṭṭf tt ɣ tggira n lmut n baba-s Ɛli mmi-s n Abi Ṭalib iṛḍa Rbbi fllas s ccahada, tqqim ɣ ugʷns n sḍiṣ ayyurn ar sa.
ummah/umayyad/am-al-jamaa|lines.1: Ssebba d ma s iskr: iǧǧa Lḥasan iṛḍa Rbbi fllas lxilafa bac ad iḥḍu idammn n imslmn, ixs ad imun awal n lumma, ad kmmlnt iseggʷasn n tbḍḍa d umnaɣ.
ummah/umayyad/am-al-jamaa|lines.2: Lbcara n nnbi: inna nnbi ﷺ: «Mmi ad iga ssid, ahat Llah ad s issgad gr snat tqbilin timqqranin zɣ imslmn» (iwala t Lbuxari).
ummah/umayyad/am-al-jamaa|lines.3: Ssebba n yism: mmunn gis imslmn ddaw yat taɣda, bayɛan Muɛawiya mmi-s n Abi Sufyan iṛḍa Rbbi fllas, s ad tbda ddula talʔumawit.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-1|title: Ssbab n umuttg s tira tunṣibt
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-1|lines.0: Lmut n imqqurn n lḥuffaḍ: tmɣur tmazirt n ddula, mmutn bahra n ṣṣaḥaba d imqqurn n ttabiɛin niɣ nɣan ɣ imgalln d tmizar, ar ttiggʷdn lɛulama ad iǧlu ulmud s lmut n wid t ittasin.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-1|lines.1: Abayyn n lfitan d tskrkas: bdan imnaɣn d tiggayin, d urmmu n «uskar n lḥadit» (lḥadit n tskrkas), s ad iqqan ad ttyaran ssunna, ad ttusmuḍ, ad ttusmyaz.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-2|lines.0: Lamr n Ɛumar mmi-s n Ɛbd Lɛaziz (immut 101 H): amzwaru n win yumrn s tira tunṣibt, yura i Abi Bakr mmi-s n Ḥazm d lwulat: «Ẓṛ ma illan zɣ lḥadit n rrasul n Llah ﷺ tarat, acku iggʷdɣ ad iǧlu ulmud ad ddun lɛulama».
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-2|lines.1: Lmam Ibn Cihab Zzuhri (immut 124 H): amzwaru n win yuran lḥadit s ubrid anṣib s lamr ad, ismun ssunan d lʔatar ɣ idlisn lli ttusnɣlnin s ddula, tuzn tn s tmizar.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-2|lines.2: Ṣṣifa n tira talʔumawit: amun amata ismunn kullu; ttyaranin lʔaḥadit lmarfuɛa ttumyaxlaḍnt d lfatawi n ṣṣaḥaba d wawal n ttabiɛin, bla asmmas iqqan niɣ abḍḍu s isntal gr tiwwura n tussna.
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-3|lines.0: Tinqqiḍin n liɛrab: asbdd n tggira n wawalen s tnqqiḍin s ufus n Abi Lʔaswad Dduʔali (immut 69 H).
ummah/umayyad/umayyad-3|lines.1: Tinqqiḍin n liɛjam: asmyaz n isekkilen ittmcabahn s tnqqiḍin ɣ uzmz n Ɛbd Lmalik mmi-s n Marwan, s ufus n Naṣr mmi-s n Ɛaṣim d Yaḥya mmi-s n Yaɛmar.
ummah/abbasid|subtitle: Azmz n uwrɣ n tira d usmmas s tiwwura
ummah/abbasid|summary: Azmz Alɛabbasi iga tiɣmirt n tmmaḍ d tfulki n tussna; ɣ mmuttgnt tussniwin zɣ idlisn n umun amata s tussniwin ttmyaznin, ittuzdgnin, ttusmmasnin s tiwwura s ibrdan n tussna iqqanin.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-1|title: Amyaz n tussniwin d ubrid n usmmas s tiwwura
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-1|lines.0: Abḍḍu n tussniwin d tzlayt: tmyaz tussna n lḥadit d lfiqh, d tussna n ttafsir s yiman nns, d llant tussniwin n lala i tnmmalt n uḍris n ccrɛ.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-1|lines.1: Amuttg zɣ umun s usmmas s tiwwura: asmmas n lktub f tiwwura n lfiqh s isntal (lktab n ṭṭhara, tẓallit, lbuyuɛ...) niɣ f lmasanid n irgazn.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|title: Tira n kkuẓ lmaḍahib n lfiqh timqqranin
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|lines.0: Lmaḍhab alḥanafi: tira n lfiqh n Abi Ḥanifa Nnuɛman (immut 150 H) s lktub n inlmadn nns, ugar «Ḍahir rriwaya» n Muḥammad mmi-s n Lḥasan Ccaybani.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|lines.1: Lmaḍhab almaliki: tira n Malik mmi-s n Anas (immut 179 H) i lktab nns «Lmuwaṭṭaʔ», ismun gr lḥadit d lfiqh d lxdmt n ayt Lmadina.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|lines.2: Lmaḍhab accafiɛi: tira n Muḥammad mmi-s n Idris Ccafiɛi (immut 204 H) i lktab «Lʔumm» ɣ lfiqh, d lktab «Rrisala» (amzwaru n lktab lli d aɣ ilkmn ɣ uṣul lfiqh).
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-2|lines.3: Lmaḍhab alḥanbali: tira n lfiqh n Aḥmad mmi-s n Ḥanbal (immut 241 H) s inlmadn nns, d lmawsuɛa nns tamqqrant n lḥadit «Musnad Lmam Aḥmad».
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-3|title: Tankra n usmuḍ n lḥadit d sḍiṣ lktub ṣṣiḥaḥ
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-3|lines.0: Ṣṣaḥiḥan: tira n «Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari» (immut 256 H) d «Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim» n unlmad nns (immut 261 H); gan lktub ugar iṣḥḥan ɣ tggira n Lqurʔan, s lmizan ugar iqqann n lisnad d usswingm.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-3|lines.1: Kkuẓ ssunan: Sunan Abi Dawud, Ttirmiḍi, Nnasaʔi, d Ibn Maja, s ad kmmlnt sḍiṣ lktub ittusnadnin.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|title: Tussniwin n lala lli ittxdamn aḍris n Lqurʔan d lḥadit
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.0: Nnaḥw d tutlayt: tafulki n snat tinmlin n Lbaṣra d Lkufa d tira n ilugan (zund «Lktab» n Sibawayh) bac ad ittuḥḍa yils aɛrab d ufham iṣḥan.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.1: Ttafsir amawsuɛi: tira n Lmam Ibn Jarir Ṭṭabari (immut 310 H) i lktab nns «Jamiɛ lbayan ɛan taʔwil ay Lqurʔan», d amzwaru n lmarajiɛ n ttafsir.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.2: Tussna n uṣul lfiqh: abddad n ilugan imqqurn n usufɣ n lʔaḥkam zɣ tmatarin nsn.
ummah/abbasid/abbasid-4|lines.3: Tussna n rrijal d ljarḥ d ttaɛdil: abayyn n allal n usmuḍ bac ad ttyasan lɛadala d ubddad n imsiwln, ad ttuḥḍa ssunna zɣ ma gis ikcmn.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams|title: Imam n lḥadit n nnbi d ṣṣiḥaḥ d ssunan (lqrn wis 3 H)
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/bukhari|lines: Isem d udɣar: Muḥammad mmi-s n Ismaɛil Lbuxari, ilul ɣ Buxara, inkkr ɣ timdinin n umaḍal aslmn ar ismun ar isnqqay ssunna.
Lktab amqqran: «Ljamiɛ lmusnad ṣṣaḥiḥ lmuxtaṣar min umur rasul Llah ﷺ wa sunanih wa ayyamih» (Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari).
Lktab ugar iṣḥḥan ɣ tggira n lktab n Llah taɛala, s umsasa n lɛulama n lumma.
Ittrar tiskfal ugar ifulkin n ṣṣḥt: tuqqna n ssnad, lɛadala n imsiwln d ubddad nnsn ikmmln, asbdd n umlilli d tilin ɣ yan uzmz, d tnjjit zɣ ccuḍuḍ d lɛilla.
Ittusan s lfiqh n izwal n tiwwura nns iqqanin, ar ttinin: «Lfiqh n Lbuxari ɣ izwal n tiwwura nns a illa».
Lktub yaḍnin: «Lʔadab lmufrad», «Ttarix lkabir», d «Xalq afɛal lɛibad».
Isem d udɣar: Muslim mmi-s n Lḥajjaj Lqucayri Nnaysaburi, anlmad n Lbuxari d yan zɣ imam n lḥuffaḍ.
Lktab amqqran: «Lmusnad ṣṣaḥiḥ lmuxtaṣar bi naql lɛadl ɛan lɛadl ila rasul Llah ﷺ» (Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim).
Gʷma-s n Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari d wis sin ɣ lktub ugar iṣḥḥan ɣ tggira n Lqurʔan lkrim.
Ittmyaz s ufulki n usmmas d tira; ar ismun ibrdan n lḥadit d wawal nns ɣ yan udɣar bla abḍḍu, bac ad isshl ufham n rriwaya d lfiqh nns.
Isbdu lktab nns s yat tmzwarut n ubrid ur ilin tamtilt, tga zɣ ilugan ugar iqdimn d ugar iqqann ɣ tussna n mṣṭalaḥ lḥadit d usmuḍ n lisnad.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/abu-dawud|sub: Lmam n ssunan d lfiqh n lʔaḥkam
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/abu-dawud|lin: Isem d tmẓi: Sulayman mmi-s n Lʔacɛat Ssijistani, anlmad n Lmam Aḥmad mmi-s n Ḥanbal, inkkr ɣ tmizar, izdɣ ɣ Lbaṣra.
Lktab amqqran: «Sunan Abi Dawud» (ismun ɣ ugʷns n 5,274 n lḥadit).
Aṭṭaf n lfuqahaʔ d lmujtahidin ɣ usufɣ n lʔaḥkam; ixṣṣa amun n lʔaḥadit n lʔaḥkam n lfiqh d lḥlal d lḥram, ur ismun lmawaɛiḍ d tḥkayin.
Ibayyn tasga n lʔaḥadit: ma gis illan lwahn ijhdn ibayyn t, ma fllas isusm iṣlḥ i lḥujja d lʔiɛtibar.
Inna fllas Lxaṭṭabi: «Lktab n Ssunan n Abi Dawud iga lktab ccrif; ur ittyara ɣ tussna n ddin yan lktab irwas as».
Lktub yaḍnin: «Risalat Abi Dawud ila ahl Makka», d «Nnasix wa lmansux», d «Lmarasil».
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/tirmidhi|subt: Bab n ssunan d lfiqh n lḥadit
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/tirmidhi|line: Isem d tmẓi: Muḥammad mmi-s n Ɛisa mmi-s n Sawra Ttirmiḍi, anlmad n Lbuxari amqqran, ilul imɣur ɣ Tirmiḍ ɣ tmizar n Ma waraʔ nnahr.
Ismun gr lḥadit d lfiqh n ṣṣaḥaba d ttabiɛin d lfuqahaʔ n tmizar (Abu Ḥanifa, Malik, Ccafiɛi, d Aḥmad), ar ibayyan win iṭṭfn s lḥadit d win t iǧǧan.
Amzwaru n usbdd n tiskfal n lḥadit d imsmyaḍ nns; amzwaru n win issnmalan asmmas: (ṣaḥiḥ, ḥasan, ɣarib, ḥasan ṣaḥiḥ).
Ilmmaḍ s ubayyn n lɛilal n lʔaḥadit d ismawn n imsiwln d lkuna nnsn s tɣara ifulkin bahra.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Ccamaʔil lmuḥammadiya» (lktab ugar imqqurn d ugar ittusnan ɣ ṣṣifat n nnbi ﷺ d lʔaxlaq nns), d «Lɛilal lkabir».
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.0: Isem d tmẓi: Aḥmad mmi-s n Cuɛayb mmi-s n Ɛli Nnasaʔi, s «Nasa» ɣ Xurasan, imuddu ɣ utrr n lḥadit s Lḥijaz d Lɛiraq d Ccam d Maṣr, izdɣ ɣ Maṣr.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.1: Lktab amqqran: «Ssunan ṣṣuɣra» lli ttinin «Lmujtaba» (Sunan Nnasaʔi), isti tt zɣ lktab nns «Ssunan lkubra».
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.3: Ittḥḍḍa bahra ɣ irgazn; tiwtilin nns gant zɣ tid ugar iqqanin ɣ ayt ssunan, d lktab nns ugar n ssunan ɣ tggira n Ṣṣaḥiḥayn ur gis llin bahra lʔaḥadit iḍɛfn.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.4: Ilmmaḍ s tɣara ɣ lɛilal n lʔaḥadit d umxalaf n wawal n imsiwln d ibrdan nnsn.
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/nasai|lines.5: Lktub yaḍnin: «Ssunan lkubra», d «Ḍḍuɛafaʔ wa lmatrukun», d «Ɛamal lyawm wa llayla».
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/ibn-majah|sub: Win issmdn sḍiṣ lktub, bab n usmmas ifulkin s tiwwura
ummah/abbasid/hadith-imams/ibn-majah|lin: Isem d tmẓi: Muḥammad mmi-s n Yazid Rrabaɛi Lqazwini, ilul ɣ Qazwin, imuddu s Lɛiraq d Ccam d Lḥijaz d Maṣr ɣ utrr n lḥadit.
Lktab amqqran: «Sunan Ibn Maja» (lktab wis sḍiṣ ittusnadn ɣ ssunan).
Ittmyaz s ufulki n usmmas d tɣara n tiwwura d tsɣart n usatal n lfiqh (4,341 n lḥadit ttubḍḍanin f 32 n lktab d 1500 n tggurt).
Ittusan s «Zawaʔid Ibn Maja»: iwala waḥdut ɣ ugʷns n 1339 n lḥadit ur d ssufɣn ayt smmus lktub izwarn, gisn ṣṣaḥiḥ d lḥasan d ḍḍaɛif.
Bddn ugar n imam n lḥadit (zɣ uzmz n Ibn Ṭahir Lmaqdisi) f is iga wis sḍiṣ ɣ sḍiṣ lktub, s lfwayd nns d zzawaʔid nns ur ilin tamtilt.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Tafsir Ibn Maja» (iǧla), d «Tarix Qazwin».
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams|title: Imqqurn n ttafsir d lmawsuɛat n ubayyn n Lqurʔan
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/tabari|subtit: Ccix n lmufassirin d lmam n lmuʔarrixin
Adɣar d lmqam: Muḥammad mmi-s n Jarir Ṭṭabari, lmam mujtahid ismun gr tussniwin n ttafsir d lḥadit d lfiqh d lqiraʔat d ttarix.
Lktab amqqran ɣ ttafsir: «Jamiɛ lbayan ɛan taʔwil ay Lqurʔan» (Tafsir Ṭṭabari).
Aṭṭaf amzwaru ɣ ttafsir s lmaʔtur d lktab ugar imqqurn ɣ lktub n ttafsir akkʷ.
Ar d issaɣ laya, ukan ar d issaɣ rriwayat s ssnad zɣ nnbi ﷺ d ṣṣaḥaba d ttabiɛin, ar issmsasa lʔasanid ar isti gr wawalen.
Asmrs iqqan n tussniwin n taɛrabt, nnaḥw, d ccawahid n ccɛr, d ubayyn n lqiraʔat n Lqurʔan d lfiqh n lʔaḥkam.
Lktab n ttarix: «Tarix rrusul wa lmuluk» (Tarix Ṭṭabari), lmarjiɛ amqqran ɣ ttarix n tuznin d lumma.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/zamakhshari|s: Bab n «Lkaccaf» ɣ lbalaɣa n Lqurʔan
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/zamakhshari|l: Isem d llqb: Maḥmud mmi-s n Ɛumar Zzamaxcari, ttinin as «Jar Llah» acku izdɣ bahra ɣ tama n Makka lmukarrama.
Lktab amqqran: «Lkaccaf ɛan ḥaqaʔiq ɣawamiḍ ttanzil wa ɛuyun lʔaqawil fi wujuh ttaʔwil».
Zɣ lktub ugar ittusnan ɣ ttafsir n lbalaɣa d lbayan; ikccf lʔasrar n nnaḍm n Lqurʔan d tɣawsiwin iqqann n liɛjaz d tussniwin n lmaɛani d lbayan.
Asmrs n uɣaras n usqsi d tririt («Iɣ tnnit... nniɣ...») bac ad ittuqllab ɣ wudmawn n lmɛna, ad d ittusufɣ ma gis ifulkin.
Wakkʷa lʔiɛtizal nns ɣ lɛaqida lli fllas nbbhn lɛulama, iqqim lktab nns d lmarjiɛ ur gis izzgir ḥtta yan lmufassir ɣ ufham n lʔasrar n lfaṣaḥa d liɛrab.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Asas lbalaɣa», d «Lmufaṣṣal fi ɛilm lɛarabiya», d «Lfaʔiq fi ɣarib lḥadit».
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.0: Isem d lmqam: Muḥammad mmi-s n Ɛumar mmi-s n Lḥusayn Rrazi, ttinin as «Ibn Xaṭib Rrayy» d «Lmam», ismun gr nnql d lɛql d uṣul ddin.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.1: Lktab amqqran: «Mafatiḥ lɣayb» (Ttafsir lkabir) ɣ 32 n tsdlist.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.3: Ilmmaḍ bahra s tussna n «lmunasabat» gr lʔayat d ssur, d ubayyn n umsasa n ugbur n Lqurʔan lkrim.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.4: Lmawsuɛa n lɛql tmɣurt; izayd ɣ ufṣṣl n tussniwin n ddunit d tmatarin n ttawḥid s lɛql.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.5: Irar gis f lfalasifa d lmuɛtazila, d usswingm iqqan n tiɣawsiwin n luṣul d lfiqh.
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/razi|lines.6: Lktub yaḍnin: «Lmaḥṣul fi ɛilm uṣul lfiqh», d «Asas ttaqdis», d «Lmaṭalib lɛaliya».
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/qurtubi|subti: Ccix n ttafsir n lfiqh d usufɣ n lʔaḥkam
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/qurtubi|lines: Isem d tmẓi: Muḥammad mmi-s n Aḥmad Lʔanṣari Lqurṭubi, ilul ɣ Qurṭuba ɣ Landalus, ukan imuddu s Maṣr, izdɣ gis, immut ɣ Lminya.
Lktab amqqran: «Ljamiɛ li aḥkam Lqurʔan wa lmubayyin lima taḍammanahu min ssunna wa ay lfurqan».
Lmawsuɛa ugar imqqurn d ugar ismunn ɣ ttafsir n lfiqh ɣ ttarix n Lislam; ismun lʔayat n lʔaḥkam ifṣṣl tiɣawsiwin nnsnt s tɣara.
Lɛadl ɣ tussna d uḍfar n tmatart; wakkʷa iga amaliki, ar ittḍfar tamatart ugar ijhdn ar tt iṣṛṛ bla taɛaṣṣubt i lmaḍhab.
Ismun bahra n tussniwin: tutlayin, nnaḥw, lqiraʔat, nnasix d lmansux, d tririt f wid ibddɛn.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Ttaḍkira bi aḥwal lmawta wa umur laxira», d «Lʔasna fi carḥ asmaʔ Llah lḥusna».
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/ibn-kathir|su: Aṭṭaf n ttafsir s lmaʔtur d usmuḍ n rriwayat
ummah/abbasid/tafsir-imams/ibn-kathir|li: Isem d lmqam: Ismaɛil mmi-s n Ɛumar mmi-s n Katir Lqurayci Ddimacqi, anlmad n Ibn Taymiya d Lmizzi, d yan zɣ imqqurn n lḥuffaḍ d lmuʔarrixin.
Lktab amqqran: «Tafsir Lqurʔan lɛaḍim» (Tafsir Ibn Katir).

Amdya ugar ikmmln n ulugan: «Abrid ugar iṣḥḥan ɣ ttafsir: ad ittufssr Lqurʔan s Lqurʔan; ma ittusmmun ɣ yan udɣar ittufṣṣl ɣ wayyaḍ, iɣ ur t tufit ar tddut s ssunna, ukan s wawal n ṣṣaḥaba, ukan ttabiɛin».
Asmuḍ iqqan n lʔasanid, d usmyaz n ṣṣaḥiḥ d ḍḍaɛif s lḥukm nns zund lḥafiḍ inmmlan.
Yan umussu amzwaru ittusnbbḍn ɣ usbḍl n «lʔisraʔiliyat» d uḥḍḍar zɣ tiɣawsiwin nnsnt iɣrbn d tḥkayin nnsnt ur ṣḥḥanin ɣ tḥkayin n lanbiya d igdudn izrin.
Lktub yaḍnin: «Lbidaya wa nnihaya» (lmawsuɛa n ttarix ugar imqqurn n lumma), d «Jamiɛ lmasanid wa ssunan», d «Ṭabaqat ccafiɛiya».
ummah/mamluk|subtitle: Azmz n lmawsuɛat d ccuruḥ imqqurn n lḥadit
ummah/mamluk|summary: Azmz n Lmamalik iga tiɣmirt n tira n lmawsuɛat d ccuruḥ n ssunna n nnbi; ɣ ttfrrɣn lɛulama i umun n ma ibḍḍan zɣ tussniwin d uḥḍu n ttrat aslmn ɣ tggira n tmara n uḍuḍ n Baɣdad:
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-1|title: Amussu n ccuruḥ imqqurn n lḥadit
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-1|lines.0: Tḥḍa ikmmln s Ljamiɛ ṣṣaḥiḥ n Lbuxari d Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim d ssunan, d usswingm n tiɣawsiwin iqqann n lisnad d tutlayt d lfiqh n lʔaḥkam.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-1|lines.1: Abayyn n «Fatḥ lbari» n Ibn Ḥajar zund ccrḥ ugar imqqurn n lḥadit, d «Ɛumdat lqari» n Lɛayni, d «Carḥ Nnawawi ɛala Muslim».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-2|title: Tafulki n tussniwin n mṣṭalaḥ lḥadit d rrijal
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-2|lines.0: Asswingm n tussniwin n lḥadit d ubddad n ilugan n lmuṣṭalaḥ s ubnu f «Muqaddimat Ibn Ṣṣalaḥ» (Alfiyat Lɛiraqi, d Nuxbat lfikr n Ibn Ḥajar).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-2|lines.1: Asmɣur ɣ tira n tudrt n imsiwln d ṭṭabaqat d ttarix (Tahḍib lkamal n Lmizzi, d Siyar aɛlam nnubalaʔ n Ḍḍahabi).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-3|lines.0: Tira n lmawsuɛat ismunn ɣ ttafsir d tussniwin n Lqurʔan (Lburhan n Zzarkaci, d Litqan n Ssuyuṭi).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-3|lines.1: Aḥḍu n yils aɛrab d tira n imawaln imqqurn zund «Lisan lɛarab» n Ibn Manḍur.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|subtitl: Win issdrn ssunna, ccix n lmuḥadditin d lfuqahaʔ
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.0: Isem d tmẓi: Yaḥya mmi-s n Caraf Nnawawi, ilul ɣ Nawa ɣ Ḥawran ɣ Ccam, izdɣ ɣ Dimacq, lmam n zzuhd d usswingm n lfiqh d lḥadit.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.1: Lktab amqqran ɣ ccrḥ n lḥadit: «Lminhaj carḥ Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim ibn Lḥajjaj» (Carḥ Nnawawi ɛala Muslim).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.3: Ccrḥ ammas ismunn, ɣ isswingm lfiqh n lḥadit s tɣara, ar ibayyan lmaḍahib n lɛulama d lfwayd n lʔasanid, d umxalaf n wawal n imsiwln d tutlayin nnsn.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.4: Iskr izwal i tiwwura n Ṣaḥiḥ Muslim lli ur as iga Muslim izwal ibaynn, ar gan izwal n Nnawawi a ttusnadnin dar ccurraḥ.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.5: Ismun gr tɣara n lḥadit d usswingm n lfiqh s umsasa gr lmaḍahib, s yan uɣaras ifulkin isshlan.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/nawawi|lines.6: Lktub yaḍnin imqqurn: «Riyaḍ ṣṣaliḥin» (lktab n lḥadit ugar ittwaẓnn ɣ umaḍal aslmn), «Lʔarbaɛun nnawawiya», «Lmajmuɛ carḥ Lmuhaḍḍab» (lmawsuɛa n lfiqh s umsasa ugar imqqurn), d «Tahḍib lʔasmaʔ wa lluɣat».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/dhahabi|subtit: Lmam n lmuḥadditin d lmuʔarrix n Lislam
Isem d lmqam: Muḥammad mmi-s n Aḥmad mmi-s n Ɛutman Ḍḍahabi Ddimacqi, lmuḥaddit n uzmz nns, inmmlan ɣ lɛilal n lḥadit d usmuḍ n irgazn d ttawtiq.
Lktub imqqurn ɣ tudrt n mddn d rrijal d ttarix:
«Siyar aɛlam nnubalaʔ»: lmawsuɛa ugar imqqurn d ugar ifulkin ɣ tudrt n imqqurn d lɛulama d lxulafaʔ d ayt zzuhd ɣ lqrun, ɣ 25 n tsdlist.
«Tarix Lislam wa wafayat lmacahir wa lʔaɛlam»: ttarix n lumma tamslmt aseggʷas s useggʷas ar aseggʷas n 700 H.
«Mizan lʔiɛtidal fi naqd rrijal»: lmizan n usmuḍ n imsiwln d ubayyn n wid iḍɛfn d wid ittyaǧǧan, d ukkas n tuhmt f wid ittyamann.
Lktub ɣ tussniwin n Lqurʔan d lḥadit: «Maɛrifat lqurraʔ lkibar ɛala ṭṭabaqat wa lʔaɛṣar», d «Lmuqiḍa fi ɛilm muṣṭalaḥ lḥadit».
Abrid: tidt ikmmln, lɛadl iqqan ɣ tudrt n imnaɣn d wid immsasan, d wawal isfuln ikccmn ɣ usmuḍ n rriwayat d lxbar.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ibn-hajar|subt: Amir lmuʔminin ɣ lḥadit d aneggaru n lḥuffaḍ
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ibn-hajar|line: Isem d lmqam: Aḥmad mmi-s n Ɛli mmi-s n Ḥajar Lɛasqalani Lkinani, qaḍi lquḍat ɣ Maṣr d ccix n Lislam ɣ uzmz nns.
Lktab amqqran: «Fatḥ lbari bi carḥ Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari» (tira nns d usɣrd nns ṭṭfn 25 n useggʷas, ttinin fllas: «Ur tlli lhijra ɣ tggira n Lfatḥ»).
Tiɣmirt n ccuruḥ n lḥadit n nnbi akkʷ; ifsi tiɣawsiwin iwɛrn ɣ Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari, iqqn lmuɛallaqat nns, ismun ibrdan akkʷ n lḥadit d wawal nns zɣ ugensu n lktub n ssunna.
Isufɣ ifḍan n lfwayd n lfiqh d luṣul d tutlayt, ismuḍ lʔasanid s lmizan ugar iqqann n lḥadit.
Isbdu t s yat tmzwarut tamqqrant «Hady ssari», ɣ ifṣṣl ilugan n Ljamiɛ ṣṣaḥiḥ d izwal nns, irar ccubuhat f irgazn nns.

Lktub n lḥadit d lmuṣṭalaḥ: «Nuxbat lfikr fi muṣṭalaḥ ahl lʔatar» d ccrḥ nns «Nuzhat nnaḍar» (tira ugar iqqann n ilugan n lmuṣṭalaḥ), «Tahḍib ttahḍib», «Taqrib ttahḍib», d «Buluɣ lmaram min adillat lʔaḥkam».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|subtitle: Qaḍi lquḍat d lmawsuɛa n ccrḥ n Lbuxari
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.0: Isem d tmẓi: Maḥmud mmi-s n Aḥmad Lɛayni Lḥanafi, ilul ɣ Ɛayn Tab ɣ Ḥalab, imuddu s Dimacq d Lqahira, iṭṭf lqaḍaʔ n lḥanafiya d lḥisba.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.1: Lktab amqqran: «Ɛumdat lqari fi carḥ Ṣaḥiḥ Lbuxari» ɣ ugʷns n 25 n tsdlist.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.3: Lmawsuɛa tamqqrant n tutlayt d liɛrab d lfiqh; s a immnaɣ d lḥafiḍ Ibn Ḥajar lli dids illan ɣ yan uzmz, mmun ɣ wakud n tira.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.4: Abrid ur ilin tamtilt ɣ usmmas n ccrḥ: ar ibḍḍu ccrḥ n kraygatt lḥadit s ifrdisn ittusbadun: (abayyn n irgazn nns, abayyn n tutlayin nns, liɛrab nns, asufɣ n lmaɛani d lbayan, ukan asufɣ n lʔaḥkam n lfiqh d lmaḍahib n imam d nnṣr n lfiqh alḥanafi s tmatart nns).
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.5: Asmɣur amqqran ɣ tiɣawsiwin n nnaḥw d ṣṣarf d ubddad n wawalen iɣrbn d ttarix n imqqurn.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/ayni|lines.6: Lktub yaḍnin: «Carḥ Sunan Abi Dawud», «Maɣani lʔaxyar fi rijal maɛani lʔatar», d «Ɛiqd ljuman fi tarix ahl zzaman».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|subtitl: Aneggaru n ayt lmawsuɛat d bab n umun n ttrat
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.0: Isem d lmqam: Ɛbd Rraḥman mmi-s n Abi Bakr Ssuyuṭi, lmam amawsuɛi lkmnt lktub nns ɣ ugʷns n 600 n lktab ɣ tussniwin akkʷ.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.1: Lktub imqqurn ɣ ttafsir d tussniwin n Lqurʔan:
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.2: «Litqan fi ɛulum Lqurʔan»: lmarjiɛ amawsuɛi ugar imqqurn ɣ tussniwin n Lqurʔan ɣ ttarix, isnbbḍ gis 80 n wanaw zɣ tussniwin n lwaḥy.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.3: «Ddurr lmantur fi ttafsir bi lmaʔtur»: amun ugar imqqurn n lʔaḥadit d lʔatar n nnbi d ṣṣaḥaba ɣ ttafsir n lʔayat n Lqurʔan lkrim.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.4: «Tafsir Ljalalayn»: s a ismmd ttafsir n Jalal Ddin Lmaḥalli, iga ttafsir ugar ittusnan imẓẓin isshlan lli ttɣran mddn.
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.5: Ljhd ɣ ccuruḥ n lḥadit d ssunna:
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.6: «Tadrib rrawi fi carḥ Taqrib Nnawawi»: aṭṭaf n tussna n lmuṣṭalaḥ, d ccrḥ n Sunan Nnasaʔi d Ibn Maja, d lktab nns ismunn «Ljamiɛ ṣṣaɣir».
ummah/mamluk/mamluk-imams/suyuti|lines.7: Abrid: azzrb ɣ umun, tɣara ɣ usmmas d tira, d uḥḍu n iḍrisn n lmaxṭuṭat lli iǧlan i lumma.
ummah/ottoman|subtitle: Tḥḍa n lmuṣḥaf d ubddad n lmaḍahib
ummah/ottoman|summary: Iẓṛa uzmz Alɛutmani yat tsurft tamqqrant n ubddad n ccrɛ d tsgiwin, ittmyazn s tḥḍa n lmuṣḥaf ccrif d usnbbḍ n lfiqh s ilugan d usmmd n ccuruḥ:
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-1|title: Taẓuri n tira n lmuṣḥaf ccrif d lxaṭṭ aɛrab
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-1|lines.0: Tlkm tira n lmṣaḥf tiɣmirt n tɣara d tifawt ɣ Isṭanbul s ufus n imqqurn n ixṭṭaṭn n lmṣaḥf (Lḥafiḍ Ɛutman, Aḥmad Qara Ḥiṣari).
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-1|lines.1: Ar d iffɣ wawal n ttarix: «Iḍr Lqurʔan ɣ Makka, ittuɣra ɣ Maṣr, ittyara ɣ Isṭanbul».
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-2|title: Abddad n lmaḍhab alḥanafi d usnbbḍ amaynu s ilugan
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-2|lines.0: Asnad n lfiqh alḥanafi d lmaḍhab anṣib n lqaḍaʔ d ddula ɣ tmizar akkʷ.
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-2|lines.1: Tira n «Majallat lʔaḥkam lɛadliya» zund tira tamzwarut tamaynut n lfiqh aslmn s ilugan, ɣ talɣa n ifrdisn n lqanun ismunn.
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-3|title: Ccuruḥ imqqurn d lḥawaci n ttafsir d lḥadit
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-3|lines.0: Tafulki n lḥawaci ittuswingmn i lktub n imam izrin (Ḥaciyat Ibn Ɛabidin ɣ lfiqh, d Ḥaciyat Ljamal ɛala Ljalalayn ɣ ttafsir).
ummah/ottoman/ottoman-3|lines.1: Abayyn n lmawsuɛat n ttafsir ismunn zund «Ruḥ lmaɛani» n Lʔalusi, d lktub n umun n lqiraʔat d ubddad n ttajwid.
